question: Anaerobic respiration of glucose in the muscles produces __________.
solution: The correct answer is __Lactic acid __ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Cellular respiration is a breakdown of a complex molecule into simpler forms and also results in the release of energy. • In the presence of oxygen aerobic respiration occurs. • In the absence of oxygen anaerobic respiration occurs. • Anaerobic respiration in our body muscles produces Lactic acid and energy. • In the absence of oxygen, pyruvate is converted to form lactic acid, and energy is released. • It leads to muscle cramps and pain.
